Disclaimer

Thunder Bay International Airport Authority receives flight information from airlines and forwards it to you. Airlines are responsible for the accuracy of flight information. Flight information can change at any time. Always confirm flight arrival and departure information with your airline and check airport monitors for last minute updates.

The Airport Authority is not liable for undelivered messages and does not guarantee the timeliness or reliability of messages sent to you or your service provider.

Always confirm flight arrival and departure information with your airline’s dedicated website. Visit our Airlines page for airline contact information.

Thunder Bay International Airport Authority receives and presents the following flight information from an external resource. Airlines are responsible for the accuracy of flight information. Remember that flight information can change at any time, and that the most current information may not yet be presented here.

Land Acknowledgement

The Thunder Bay International Airports Authority acknowledges that we are situated on the traditional territory of the Anishinaabe Peoples and within the Robinson-Superior Treaty of 1850. We recognize the enduring presence and stewardship of Fort William First Nation, signatory to this treaty, and honour their ongoing connection to the land on which we operate. We also acknowledge the Métis people, whose historical and ongoing presence enriches this region, and we honour their contributions and connection to this land on which we operate.
